unruled:ny_city_rs#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A: "One spouse is a New York State resident and the other is a nonresident or part-year resident. In this case, you must either: file separate New York returns ... or file jointly, as if you both were New York State residents". A joint federal return reaches this only through ny_it201.ask.spouse_resident ('Did your husband or wife also live in New York City for all of 2025?', asked on a joint return): a No makes ny_it201.spouse_not_resident true, and ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident (a choice on f1040.status: mfj reads spouse_not_resident; single, mfs, hoh and qss give no) refuses ny_it201.line1 ('Separate New York returns, or a joint return taxing both as residents'); a refused IT-201 is a refused New York profile, so the status item of this form is never produced for that case. A federal separate return keeps New York status 3, which the exception does not change.

unruled:ny_it201#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 20, Line 69a: a City resident who 'marked Yes at item C ... do[es] not qualify to claim this credit'. The encoding does zero it: ny_it201.line69a chooses ny_it201.zero_stc when ny_it201.item_c is true and ny_it201.stc_rr only when item_c is false (forms/ny/2025/ny_it201.yaml:2643-2653); the reviewer missed the choose on line 69a itself.

unruled:ny_it201#1.2.evidence: ny_it201i p. 7: 'Write each type of income and each adjustment and its amount in the Identify areas on lines 16 and 18' and the overflow sheet. These are descriptive entries beside the amount of ny_it201.line16; no amount changes.

unruled:ny_it201#1.3.evidence: ny_it201i p. 7, the same Identify-area sentences for line 18: a list of each federal adjustment beside the total in ny_it201.line18; no amount changes.

unruled:ny_it201#1.4.evidence: ny_it201i p. 5, Item F: 'Enter in the applicable box the number of months you and your spouse ... lived in New York City during 2025.' An entry on the return that changes no amount; a part-year City resident is refused by ny_it201.gate.part_year_city (same claim as an earlier subject, rechecked).

unruled:ny_it2#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 21, 'If you received foreign income but did not receive a federal Form W-2, you must complete Form IT-2.' Foreign pay with no Form W-2 is refused federally by scope.pay_no_w2 ('Wages, tips, or strike or lockout pay not on a W-2'), and income excluded as earned abroad by sa.excluded_income, so no New York return reaches IT-2 with such income.

unruled:ny_it201#1.5.evidence: ny_it201i p. 6, Item H: 'If you have more than seven dependents and are filing a paper return, attach a separate sheet marked Form IT-201: Item H continued'. The only amount item H drives is the line 36 exemption (p. 9, 'Multiply the number of your dependents listed on ... item H ... by 1,000'), which reads ny_it201.item_h_count; the continuation sheet is an attachment.

unruled:ny_it201#1.7.evidence: ny_it201i pp. 23-24: electronic funds withdrawal details, 'You must specify a future payment date up to and including April 15, 2026', and Form IT-201-V for a check. Payment-method entries and a voucher; the balance due in ny_it201.line80 is unchanged.
